title: Pure Zoodiac
summary: Zoodiac revolutionized Xyz Summoning by allowing every Zoodiac Rank 4 Xyz Monster (Drident, Chakanine, Tigermortar, Boarbow, and Hammerkong) to be Xyz Summoned once per turn by overlaying directly on top of ANY 1 'Zoodiac' monster you control with a different name! Fully compliant with the current TCG Banlist (where Zoodiac Broadbull is Forbidden, and Zoodiac Drident, Zoodiac Barrage, and Zoodiac Ratpier are each Limited to 1 copy), any single Zoodiac Normal Summon (or Zoodiac Barrage / Fire Formation - Tenki) stacks through Hammerkong -> Tigermortar -> Chakanine -> Boarbow! Going first, end on Zoodiac Drident (Quick Effect face-up card destruction) loaded with Zoodiac Whiptail (non-targeting battle banish) and Kataroost/Bunnyblast protection alongside Zoodiac Combo to recycle 5 Zoodiacs and draw 1 card; going second, attack directly with Zoodiac Boarbow and stack a 5-to-6-material Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder on top of it in Main Phase 2 to wipe the board up to 3 times!

allow.Fire Formation - Tenki: Continuous Spell that adds any Level 4 Beast-Warrior 'Zoodiac' monster (Ratpier, Thoroughblade, Whiptail, or Ramram!) from your Deck to your hand and boosts all Zoodiac monsters on the field by 100 ATK.
allow.Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder: Rank 12 Machine Xyz boss (3000 ATK / 3000 DEF): because every Zoodiac Xyz Monster can stack on top of another Zoodiac Xyz Monster and Zoodiac Boarbow can attack your opponent directly, a single Zoodiac monster attacks directly as Boarbow and immediately overlays into a 5-to-6-material AA-ZEUS in Main Phase 2 (detaching 2 materials as a Quick Effect—not once per turn!—to send all other cards on the field to the GY)!
allow.Infinitrack Fortress Megaclops: Link-3 EARTH Machine boss (3 Xyz Monsters; 4000 ATK): using Zoodiac Chakanine and Zoodiac Tigermortar to revive Zoodiacs from your GY and overlay 1-card Zoodiac Xyz Monsters on top of them easily puts 3 Xyz Monsters on your field to Link Summon Megaclops (which is unaffected by non-Xyz monster effects and revives a Zoodiac Xyz from your GY to destroy an opponent's card and attach a material!)!
allow.Bujinki Ahashima: Link-2 monster that summons 2 Level 4 Zoodiac monsters (1 from hand, 1 from GY) to Xyz Summon a Rank 4 Zoodiac without using its 1-material Xyz Summon clause!

main: Zoodiac Ratpier
Limited to 1 in TCG: when Normal Summoned, sends ANY 'Zoodiac' card ('Zoodiac Ramram', 'Zoodiac Thoroughblade', or 'Zoodiac Combo'!) from your Deck to the GY!
Zoodiac Thoroughblade

Core Level 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior (1600 ATK): when Normal or Special Summoned, discards 1 'Zoodiac' card to draw 1 card; and grants any Beast-Warrior Xyz Monster that has it as material +1600 ATK and piercing battle damage!
Zoodiac Whiptail

Core Level 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior (1200 ATK / 400 DEF): Quick Effect during either player's turn to target 1 Beast-Warrior Xyz Monster you control and attach this card from your hand or field to it as Xyz Material—granting it +1200 ATK/+400 DEF AND the effect to banish any opponent's monster it battles after damage calculation!
Zoodiac Ramram

Core Level 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior (400 ATK / 2000 DEF): if this card is destroyed by battle or card effect (such as by Zoodiac Barrage, Zoodiac Drident, or Zodiac Sign!), targets 1 'Zoodiac' monster in your GY (including a Zoodiac Xyz Monster!) and Special Summons it; and grants targeting Trap negation as Xyz Material!
Zoodiac Bunnyblast

Level 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior (800 ATK / 800 DEF): if destroyed by battle or card effect, targets 1 'Zoodiac' card in your GY (such as Zoodiac Barrage!) and adds it back to your hand; and grants targeting Spell negation as Xyz Material!
Zoodiac Kataroost

Level 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior (800 ATK / 1200 DEF): if destroyed by battle or card effect, shuffles 1 'Zoodiac' card from your GY into the Deck; and grants targeting Monster effect negation as Xyz Material!
Zoodiac Barrage

Limited to 1 in TCG: iconic Continuous Spell that targets 1 face-up card you control (including itself, Zoodiac Ramram, or Fire Formation - Tenki!), destroys it, and Special Summons any 'Zoodiac' monster directly from your Deck; and attaches itself from GY to a Zoodiac Xyz if destroyed!
Zodiac Sign

Archetypal Field Spell: all 'Zoodiac' monsters you control gain 300 ATK/DEF; opponent's monsters cannot target Beast-Warrior monsters for attacks except your highest-ATK Beast-Warrior; and once per turn, if a 'Zoodiac' monster you control would be destroyed by battle, you can destroy 1 monster in your hand or field (Ramram or Bunnyblast!) instead!
Fire Formation - Tenki

Core Continuous Spell: adds ANY Level 4 Beast-Warrior 'Zoodiac' monster from your Deck to your hand on activation and boosts all Zoodiacs by 100 ATK (and can be destroyed by Zoodiac Barrage after resolving!).
Zoodiac Combo

Core Normal Trap: targets 1 'Zoodiac' Xyz Monster you control and attaches 1 'Zoodiac' monster (Whiptail or Kataroost!) directly from your Deck to it as Xyz Material; during either turn (except the turn it was sent to the GY), banishes itself from your GY to shuffle 5 'Zoodiac' cards with different names from your GY into the Deck/Extra Deck (recycling your Limited 1-of Zoodiac Drident!) and draw 1 card!
Zoodiac Gathering

Continuous Trap: if a 'Zoodiac' Xyz Monster you control would be destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect, you can detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster you control instead; banishes from GY to attach 1 Zoodiac Xyz you control to another as material!
extra: Limited to 1 in TCG: signature Rank 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior Xyz boss: once per turn can be Xyz Summoned using 1 'Zoodiac' monster you control with a different name; gains the combined ATK/DEF of all Zoodiac materials attached to it; and once per turn (Quick Effect), detaches 1 material to target 1 face-up card on the field and destroy it!

Core Rank 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior Xyz: once per turn detaches 1 material to target 1 'Zoodiac' monster in your GY and Special Summon it (which you can then immediately overlay with Zoodiac Tigermortar, who attaches a material to the revived monster, or use to climb into Infinitrack Fortress Megaclops!)!

Core Rank 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior Xyz: once per turn detaches 1 material to target 1 Xyz Monster you control and 1 'Zoodiac' monster in your GY (such as Thoroughblade for +1600 ATK or Whiptail for battle banishing!) and attach that GY Zoodiac to that Xyz Monster as material!

Core Rank 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior Xyz: can attack your opponent DIRECTLY—allowing any single Zoodiac monster to stack through Hammerkong -> Tigermortar -> Chakanine -> Boarbow, attack directly, and stack into a 5-to-6-material Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder in Main Phase 2!

Rank 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior Xyz: serves as an extra Zoodiac Xyz name to stack materials for AA-ZEUS, and while it has Xyz Material, prevents your opponent from targeting other face-up 'Zoodiac' monsters on the field with card effects!

Rank 12 LIGHT Machine Xyz boss (3000 ATK / 3000 DEF): Xyz Summons directly on top of Zoodiac Boarbow in Main Phase 2 with 4 to 6 Xyz Materials attached—giving you 2 to 3 non-once-per-turn Quick Effect board wipes that send all other cards on the field to the GY!

Link-3 EARTH Machine boss (3 Xyz Monsters; 4000 ATK): summoned by using Chakanine and Tigermortar to revive Zoodiacs and overlay 3 Zoodiac Xyz Monsters; unaffected by other monsters' effects (except Xyz Monsters) and revives Zoodiac Drident or Chakanine from your GY every turn to destroy an opponent's card and attach a material!
Link-2 monster that summons 1 Level 4 Zoodiac from hand and 1 from GY to Xyz Summon a Rank 4 Zoodiac without using its once-per-turn 1-material summon.
